contentBody: **What exactly is an "input slot" in a prompt template?**
option.1: The box where the AI's reply appears
option.2: The name of the model you are using
option.3: The section holding the rules and the format
option.4: The marked blank where new material goes
answerExplanation: It is where you paste the material that changes each time.

contentBody: **You keep fixing the same mistake in your AI drafts. What should you do about it?**
option.1: Add a new rule to your saved template
option.2: Stop using AI for drafts altogether
option.3: Fix it by hand every single time
option.4: Switch to a new tool weekly
answerExplanation: Each repeated fix becomes a rule, so the template improves over time.
